exceptions.reason: The chip is a real <button> only when `onClick` is passed; without it -- and nothing obliges a consumer to pass it -- it renders as a <div> with no role, no tabbable behaviour and no activation at all, and this whole pattern does not apply to that shape. This is exactly the limitation Tag's own binding records and CLAUDE.md carries in Known debt: the binding schema cannot express 'this pattern applies conditionally', so a reader of the binding alone would think the pattern always holds. This binding, and the exception below, describes CalendarEvent only in the shape it takes when `onClick` is set.

There is no disabled concept: aria-disabled is never set and there is no member that makes an event unactivatable while still drawn. A chip is either interactive (onClick passed) or inert (onClick omitted), and the inert shape is a <div> rather than a disabled button -- which is the roles.element exception above, one requirement over.
